context: 3.2. Log determinant barrier The high probability bounds for finite-armed bandits heavily rely on the fact that the comparator class is the probability simplex and the positivity of the vectors there-in. To generalize those techniques we make use of a new lifting to the space of positive definite matrices using the negative log determinant as a potential function in combination with FTRL-FB.
